heading: We have a plan for every stage

free.name: Free plan
free.description:
Everything you need to put
one agent on your site and
watch it work.

basic.name: Basic plan
basic.description:
Designed for early startups
and small projects
testing the waters.
features:
Up to 800 voice minutes
per month

Maximum of 1 company per
core user account

Up to 3 invited members
per company

pro.name: Pro plan
pro.description:
Geared towards growing
operations needing scale
and heavier workload volume.
features:
Advanced answer boundaries
for nuanced agent responses

Up to 3,000 voice minutes
per month

Up to 3 companies per
core user account

Up to 10 invited members
per company

enterprise.name: Enterprise plan
enterprise.description:
Uncapped scaling for
established operations
and intensive needs.
features:
Dedicated compute tier for
the fastest response times

business.name: Business plan
business.description:
For small setups getting
started with AI support

Up to 2 invited members
per company
